text: Toronto Atmospheric Fund uses several indicators to evaluate and inform our work. The 2024 Impact Report, Working Toward Net-Zero Emissions, provides an accessible summary of results achieved, leveraging the data collected and analytical approaches Toronto Atmospheric Fund uses and continues to refine. This Impact Report complements the 2024 Annual Report which summarizes the activities and accomplishments against the approved Annual Plan and the 2024 Audited Financial Statements which presents Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s financial results.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (July 6, 2025) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, Toronto Atmospheric Fund for information.
